# dokku_app_logs (Resource)

Manages per-application Dokku log configuration (`dokku logs:set <app>`).

## Behavior and lifecycle

1. Targets an existing Dokku application (`apps:exists <app>`).
2. `max_size` changes trigger `ps:rebuild <app>` when `rebuild_on_max_size_change` is `true` (the default) so running containers pick up the updated Docker log driver `--log-opt max-size`. Non-zero exit codes from `ps:rebuild` on undeployed apps are ignored.
3. For sink DSNs containing API keys or tokens, prefer `vector_sink_wo` + `vector_sink_version` (and `vector_cron_sink_wo` + `vector_cron_sink_version`) with Terraform or OpenTofu `>= 1.11` so DSNs are not saved in plan files or Terraform state. Use `vector_sink` / `vector_cron_sink` for non-secret DSNs (e.g. `console://`) or older Terraform versions.
4. Destroying this resource unsets `max-size`, `app-label-alias`, `vector-sink`, and `vector-cron-sink` for the app (without deleting the app itself) and runs `ps:rebuild <app>` if `max_size` was set and `rebuild_on_max_size_change` is `true`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dokku_app" "api" {
  name       = "api"
  from_image = "ghcr.io/example/api:latest"
}

resource "dokku_app_logs" "api" {
  app                        = dokku_app.api.name
  max_size                   = "100m"
  app_label_alias            = "service"
  rebuild_on_max_size_change = true

  # Use vector_sink / vector_cron_sink for non-secret DSNs (or Terraform < 1.11),
  # or vector_sink_wo + vector_sink_version for DSNs containing API keys/tokens.
  vector_sink = "console://"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) Name of the existing Dokku application.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `app_label_alias` (String) Per-app Vector label alias for the Dokku app name. Omit to inherit the global Dokku setting.
- `max_size` (String) Per-app container log max size (e.g. `50m`, `1g`, or `unlimited`). Omit to inherit the global Dokku setting.
- `rebuild_on_max_size_change` (Boolean) Whether to run `ps:rebuild <app>` when `max_size` is set, changed, or unset. Undeployed apps ignore non-zero rebuild status.
- `vector_cron_sink` (String, Sensitive) Per-app Vector cron sink DSN (`SINK_TYPE://?SINK_OPTIONS`). Stored in Terraform state; prefer `vector_cron_sink_wo` for DSNs containing secrets.
- `vector_cron_sink_version` (Number) Increment to apply an updated `vector_cron_sink_wo` DSN.
- `vector_cron_sink_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only per-app Vector cron sink DSN (`SINK_TYPE://?SINK_OPTIONS`); not saved in Terraform state (requires Terraform/OpenTofu >= 1.11).
- `vector_sink` (String, Sensitive) Per-app Vector sink DSN (`SINK_TYPE://?SINK_OPTIONS`). Stored in Terraform state; prefer `vector_sink_wo` for DSNs containing secrets.
- `vector_sink_version` (Number) Increment to apply an updated `vector_sink_wo` DSN.
- `vector_sink_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only per-app Vector sink DSN (`SINK_TYPE://?SINK_OPTIONS`); not saved in Terraform state (requires Terraform/OpenTofu >= 1.11).

### Read-Only

- `computed_app_label_alias` (String) Effective app label alias (app setting or inherited global default).
- `computed_max_size` (String) Effective app log max size (app setting or inherited global default).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vector_cron_sink_fingerprint` (String, Sensitive) SHA-256 hex digest of the remote app `vector-cron-sink` DSN, or empty when unset.
- `vector_sink_fingerprint` (String, Sensitive) SHA-256 hex digest of the remote app `vector-sink` DSN, or empty when unset.

## Import

Import an app's Dokku log configuration by application name.

```shell
# Import an app's Dokku log configuration by application name.
terraform import dokku_app_logs.api api
```
